snippet.title: BLIGHTEN - Gameplay Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4462580/BLIGHTEN/

BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within
